text: Hello and welcome to live coverage of the Premier League meeting between Liverpool and Everton at Anfield!
Liverpool have the chance to go top of the Premier League table with a victory here today, and Jurgen Klopp will be looking to get his team back to winning ways.
Their seven-match winning run in all competitions came to an end with a controversial 2-1 loss to Tottenham, and the Reds were most recently held to a 2-2 by Brighton.
However, history is on their side in this fixture as they've lost just one of their last 25 league meetings with Everton (W11 D13), though that was a 2-0 home defeat in February 2021.
As for Everton, things are starting to look up for them.
After a very slow start to their season, they've now managed to win three of their last four outings in all competitions (L1).
Their first win of the campaign came away at Brentford, but they got their first victory at Goodison Park last time out as they brushed aside Bournemouth 3-0 just before the international break.
Klopp makes four changes to the side that drew with Brighton last time out.
Konate, Tsimikas, Gravenberch and Jota, who returns after serving a one-match ban, all come in.
Matip, Elliott and Nunez drop to the bench, where Kelleher is also named after recovering from a knee problem.
Andy Robertson is out with a shoulder injury he sustained on international duty.
Sean Dyche was clearly impressed with his team's performance in the win over Bournemouth two weeks ago as he names an unchanged line-up here.
They are boosted by the return of Gueye, who is on the bench after recovering from a heel injury.
The teams are out on the pitch now, with kick-off just moments away!
Doucoure gets the game under way for Everton!
McNeil whips a brilliant cross into the box for Calvert-Lewin to attack, but his header is straight at Alisson.
The keeper sets Salah away down the right, and he drives past Mykolenko, but a heavy touch shows too much of it to Pickford.
Gravenberch dinks a lovely ball over the top for Salah, who is in space on the right of the box, but he snatches at his shot, hitting it across the box instead.
Jota wasn't expecting it and can't bring it under control.
Tsimikas has acres of space down the left and he whips a wonderful, early delivery in.
Gravenberch manages to flick it on while turning, but it flicks off Szoboszlai's chest and Pickford punches it away.
Having won five of their first 11 Premier League games against Liverpool (D4 L2), Everton have now won just five of their last 51 against them in the competition (D21 L25).
Liverpool comfortably deal with an Everton free-kick and then break quickly on the counter.
Salah surges down the right before it's switched out to Diaz on the left.
Young cuts that out to give away a corner, but nothing comes of it.
GOOD BLOCK! Van Dijk clears Everton's corner, and it's swept out to Szoboszlai to break on the counter down the left.
He carries it a long way before laying it off to Diaz, but Young slides in with a brilliant tackle to deflect his shot over the bar.
It's a very open game here and Doucoure is steadily making his way up the pitch before he helps it out to Harrison on the right.
He's trying to find space for a cross, but can't get around Tsimikas.
Everton's free-kick is taken quickly, and Tsimikas is slow to close Harrison down this time.
He checks back to float a good cross to the edge of the six-yard box, but Konate clears it just in front of Calvert-Lewin.
Liverpool eventually scramble Everton's corner away and Salah hooks it forward for Diaz.
The Reds have four against three as Diaz squares it across, but Onana slides in with an excellent block to stop it from reaching Gravenberch.
Young steps across Diaz to stop him from getting into the final third, and he's shown the first yellow card of the game.
It's a wonderful switch from Mac Allister to pick out Salah, but a heavy touch gets away from him.
Everton patiently work it out from the back and win a free-kick, but it comes to nothing.
Everton just can't clear their lines and Gravenberch manages to poke it forward for Jota.
He's trying to get a sight of goal when he's tripped by Tarkowski in the D, and Liverpool have a free-kick in a dangerous position.
Salah rolls the ball slightly to the right to give Alexander-Arnold a slightly better angle from the free-kick.
He gets a lot of power into it, but he strikes it straight into the Everton wall.
Doucoure nicks it off Gravenberch, only to run straight into Szoboszlai and lose out once more.
It's more patient from Liverpool at the moment, and they're keeping Everton penned back in their own half.
Garner slides in to win it off Gravenberch, and Onana spots Alisson a long way out of his box.
He attempts an audacious effort from the edge of the centre circle in his own half, but slices at it, causing the keeper no problems.
CHANCE! Alexander-Arnold touches it into Salah, who checks back onto his left foot before whipping a shot towards goal.
He can't keep it down though and it sails over Pickford's crossbar.
Everton just can't keep hold of the ball at the moment.
Pickford goes long from a goal-kick, and Young just manages to keep it in play, but from there Liverpool quickly win it back once more.
Young takes a loose touch which sends the ball straight out of play, and then he kicks it away to stop Liverpool from being able to take a quick throw-in.
The Liverpool fans in front of it are asking for a second yellow card, but it doesn't come.
Tarkowski is late getting across to Gravenberch and cuts out his run.
He can have no complaints about the booking.
SAVE! Szoboszlai lays it off to Mac Allister, and the space opens up for him through the middle, so he tries his luck.
He drills a powerful shot at Pickford, who initially spills it but reacts quickly to get there ahead of Jota.
Everton are looking a little shaky at the back, but at the moment they're doing enough to frustrate Liverpool.
Branthwaite wins it back and hooks it upfield for Doucoure, but Van Dijk gets to it first.
YOUNG IS SENT OFF! Diaz goes up against the right-back and just manages to get a yard on him.
Young slides in trying to make sure he doesn't get into the box, but catches Diaz's leg when he shields the ball.
The Liverpool fans are asking for a second yellow and the referee shows him one.
Everton are down to 10 men!
GREAT CHANCE! Liverpool are piling the pressure on the visitors now and Van Dijk sees a header deflected out for a corner.
Tsimikas' outswinger is cleared as far as Alexander-Arnold, who catches it sweetly on the volley, and it flies just over the crossbar.
GOOD CHANCE! McNeil has three Liverpool defenders around him, but he manages to find a pocket of space as he curls a shot on goal.
It takes a slight nick off Van Dijk which has Alisson scrambling, but it sails over.
Tarkowski got in the way of Szoboszlai's shot and goes down winded, but Liverpool carry on.
Szoboszlai picks out Alexander-Arnold, who fizzes a delightful cross into the box, but none of his team-mates can get a touch.
Tsimikas' corner is flicked on by Diaz, and Onana does well to hook it away under pressure.
The left-back gets it once more and takes it to the byline before putting another cross in, but again, Onana is there to clear the danger.
Pickford lifts it over the top for Calvert-Lewin, but it hits his chest and rolls back to Alisson.
He sets Liverpool on the counter once more, and Szoboszlai takes on a powerful shot from just outside the box, but there isn't enough dip on it.
Jota slaloms his way into the box before tripping over Doucoure, who is already on the floor.
There are cries for a penalty from the Liverpool fans and players, but the referee says no.
HALF-TIME: LIVERPOOL 0-0 EVERTON.
It's goalless at the break as 10-man Everton hold on against Liverpool.
The Reds dominated the first half, but it could've been a much different story had Calvert-Lewin scored his first-minute header.
Young received two yellow cards for fouls on Diaz, with the second seeing him dismissed in the 37th minute.
Alexander-Arnold and Szoboszlai both came close for the hosts, but Pickford only had one save to make in the first half, denying Mac Allister.
Klopp will be urging his side to pick up where they left off as they look to use their man advantage.
His side have looked dangerous on the attack, but they need to test Pickford more often.
As for Dyche, he'll be pleased that they managed to get through to the break without conceding - it'll be all about staying strong defensive as they look to try and see this out in the second half.
Everton are making a double change at the break, and they're both defensive as it looks like they'll be switching to a back five.
Harrison is the first to go off, with Keane on for him.
McNeil is the other player that's making way, with Patterson on for him.
Liverpool get us back under way for the second half!
As expected, Liverpool have started the second half on the front foot and are keeping Everton penned back in their own half.
The Reds are having to be patient due to their opponents' compact shape.
Onana knocks the ball past Konate, and the Liverpool defender clumsily brings him down to stop the counter.
He goes into the book.
DOUBLE BLOCK! Patterson intercepts Szoboszlai's cross, but his clearance goes as far as Salah.
Tarkowski stretches to block his shot before throwing himself in front of Gravenberch's follow-up effort.
There are big shouts for a penalty for a handball against Keane from the Liverpool faithful.
VAR has a quick look at it, but it would've been harsh as a deflection off Gravenberch sent it towards the defender's arm, which was by his side.
Everton have a rare chance to get forward here, but Mykolenko's cross is cleared by Konate.
He gets it as far as Garner, who snatches at a first-time shot from outside the box and sends it high into the stands.
Onana races across to shield Diaz out of play, and his pace takes him over the advertising boards.
It's an awkward fall over the edge by the midfielder, but after a little while he gets back to his feet without needing treatment.
Everton just can't get out of their own half, and Mac Allister wins it back on the halfway line.
He helps it onto Jota, who flicks it into Salah's path.
Branthwaite does get across, but the offside flag is up anyway.
Both sides are making changes here, starting with Everton.
Calvert-Lewin is taken off, with Beto replacing him.
It's a double swap for Liverpool.
Tsimikas is the first to go off, with Nunez on for him.
And Gravenberch is also making way, with Elliott coming on in his place.
Liverpool's latest attack is cleared and Garner slides it forward for Beto to chase.
Konate puts an arm across him to stop the run and Everton are incensed that he isn't being shown a second yellow card for it.
SAVE! Alisson goes long and Nunez brings it down with a lovely first touch as the space opens up for him.
He drills a shot straight down the middle, but Pickford gets behind it.
As soon as the free-kick for Konate's foul was taken, Klopp decided he wasn't going to take any chances.
Konate is taken off, with Matip on for him.
Dyche is still arguing about what should've been a yellow card for Konate.
The referee has had enough and the Everton manager is booked for dissent.
Everton are still sitting deep in their own half, but they're comfortably dealing with the crosses coming in from both sides at the moment.
Diaz and Salah both curl the ball in, but it's met by a blue shirt.
More big shouts from the home fans for a penalty as Diaz goes down under a challenge from Patterson.
There was very little contact and the Colombian went down dramatically.
A VAR check confirms no spot-kick.
The Anfield crowd is up once more as Diaz's cross strikes Keane's outstretched arm.
The defender isn't too far away from it, but it's the positioning of the arm that could be the problem.
A Liverpool corner is given, but VAR is having a look at it...

PENALTY TO LIVERPOOL! The referee is called over to have a look at the incident himself, and although there's nothing deliberate about it, Keane's arm was outstretched and Craig Pawson comes back on, pointing to the spot.
SALAH SCORES! And Liverpool finally have the breakthrough! It's a confident spot-kick from the Egyptian as he powers it into the right side of the net.
Pickford barely moves off his line, but even diving the right way, there's no saving that.
1-0 Liverpool!
Everton look to try and make a quick response straight from the kick-off.
Mykolenko pulls it back to Beto on the edge of the box, but he slices his shot well wide of the far post.
Liverpool are back to dominating possession here, and it's worked out to Nunez on the left.
He swings a cross into the middle, but it's too high for Salah at the far post.
More changes for both sides, starting with Everton.
Onana, who has had a good game, goes off for Danjuma.
And for Liverpool, Gomez is brought on in place of Diaz.
SAVE! Liverpool win another corner which is put in by Alexander-Arnold and Jota meets it in the middle of the box.
He thumps his header towards goal, but it's straight at Pickford.
Salah has either scored (nine) or assisted (nine) a goal in 14 of his last 15 Premier League games, and each of his last 13 at Anfield (13 goals, three assists).
Liverpool are just happy to keep possession in front of Everton as they try to see out this win now.
They're in no hurry to push forward, and the Toffees aren't attempting to press either.
BLOCK! Everton don't get the free-kick they're asking for, and Liverpool break quickly on the counter once more.
Nunez bursts down the left before pulling it back from the byline, and Patterson just manages to head it wide, avoiding his own goal.
The final roll of the dice for Everton sees Chermiti come on for Mykolenko.
GREAT SAVE! It's more patient build-up from Liverpool, but Elliott injects some pace into it as he checks onto his left foot and whips a shot on goal.
Pickford sees it late, but gets a strong hand behind it to tip it wide.
WIDE! Jota carries it a long way down the left, and it looks like he's going to tee up Nunez through the middle, but he chooses to go it alone instead.
He fires his shot towards the near post, but only hits the side netting.
Chermiti's shot is blocked by Van Dijk, and Everton win a corner.
Pickford is asking to go up, but with five minutes still to go, Dyche isn't allowing it.
Garner swings it in, but it misses everybody in the box.
Szoboszlai weaves his way down the left and Jota's run opens up some space for him to get into the box.
He tries to curl it into the top corner, but his effort flies high and wide.

events.action: curl it into the top corner

text: SALAH SCORES AGAIN! And that will do it for Liverpool! Everton committed a lot of bodies forward in search of an equaliser, and they're caught out.
Chermiti loses the ball and Szoboszlai slides it forward for Nunez, who surges through the middle.
He has Tarkowski ahead of him so he lays it off to Salah, and he rifles a second goal past Pickford at the near post.

events.action: rifles a second goal past Pickford

text: 2-0 Liverpool!
Tarkowski is trying in vain to get across to Nunez, who races through the middle.
He could've gone for goal himself, but unselfishly picks out Salah instead.
The Everton fans are starting to file out of the stadium as Liverpool mount another attack here.
Elliott looks to loop it forward for Jota, but Branthwaite is tight to him to stop him from bringing it down.
FULL-TIME: LIVERPOOL 2-0 EVERTON.
Salah's late double helps Liverpool to a 2-0 win over 10-man Everton.
Calvert-Lewin could've made things very different if his first-minute header wasn't saved by Alisson, but the game was dominated by the Reds after that.
Young was sent off just 37 minutes in for a second yellow card, but Liverpool still struggled to break the visitors down.
The hosts also could've been down to 10 after the break, but Konate somehow managed to avoid a second booking.
VAR then awarded a penalty for a handball against Keane, which Salah confidently rifled in, and the Egyptian then finished off a counter-attack in the 97th minute to seal the points.
Liverpool go top of the table and now turn their attention to Toulouse, who they’ll face in the Europa League on Thursday.
Everton stay in 16th and will be looking to bounce back at West Ham next weekend.
That's all for today, goodbye!
